title: A nonempty embedded d-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P has d ≤ P
statement: Let P, d, r ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be a nonempty d-dimensional embedded C^r submanifold in the sense of the contract (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M: every y ∈ M has an open V ⊆ ℝ^d, an open W ∋ y and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, C^r and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for every z ∈ V). Then d ≤ P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d r : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M → M.Nonempty → d ≤ P
